text:
ان، امان، املی—ترے دھن کا واس۔
جوا، زناہ، ضامنی—ترے دھن کا ناس۔
romanized:
Ann, amān, amlī—tré dhan kā vās.
Jūā, zināh, zāmnī—tré dhan kā nās.
literal_en:
Grain, credit and official position are three abodes of (means of gaining) wealth.
Gambling, fornication and becoming surety for others are three means of losing wealth.

source.book: Grammar and Dictionary of Western Panjabi, as spoken in the Shahpur District, with Proverbs, Sayings and Verses
